Use the licensed reference car for the identity and equipment of a photorealistic ordinary BMW G20 four-door sedan from the original 2018–2022 phase, with its actual UK SE exterior. Create one new balanced front three-quarter view between a front one-third and front one-half view, with the nose pointing left. Keep body-color handles and both normally outward silver mirrors with their actual signal strips. Preserve the real UK right-hand-drive steering and wiper layout rather than converting it to left-hand drive. Retain the source-visible low silver rear roof contour with its natural front-view occlusion, without raising a new fin or inventing a hidden base. No long rod, roof rails, crossbars, sunroof or new model badge.

The identity to keep is the car’s shape and equipment; the reflected scene must change. Remove the brick building, tree, neighboring cars, road, curb and every identifiable brick or window pattern, tree silhouette, sky scene band and photographer or car reflection from its paint, glass and mirrors. Replace those mappings with clean, nonrecognizable soft studio highlights. Keep real polished silver metallic sheen and smooth glossy highlight transitions, not satin, matte, flat white or another paint color. Remove surface water droplets and the temporary windshield sticker. Keep the existing plain light front plate and frame without letters, flags or extra labels. Keep coherent clean windows and an empty cabin; retain factory emblems and physical trim.

Deliver the complete car on true transparent RGBA. All tires, mirrors, roof contour and bumper corners must be fully inside the canvas, with at least 80 pixels of transparent space above and at either side and 100 pixels below the tires. The car should occupy about 78 percent of the width. No floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, halo, checkerboard, watermark, caption or text. Do not stretch the body, change wheels or alter ride height to reconcile published dimensions. The rear, catalog and factory images are identity evidence only, not generation inputs.
